arrivalChecklist: Reveal local map information before planning a route.
Activate or identify the nearest usable travel point.
Inspect the smithy before spending refinement materials.
Inspect saddlery stock if using a Wolf or Bear special mount.
Check provisioner, equipment shop and local requests.
